biggest_catch: The official FAQ gives a $5–$9 range per 15-minute playtest — the route's '$9' is the TOP of that range, not the typical payout; plus the onboarding qualification test is unpaid and slots fill fast.
catches: Official FAQ: 'Generally, a 15 minute playtest and survey will have a reward of $5-9 USD' — $9 is the ceiling of the official range.
The Playtester Onboarding (qualification test) is unpaid.
You must pass the onboarding review to join the tester panel and start receiving paid playtests.
Opportunities are mostly for English-speaking countries; test invitations depend on your profile, gaming preferences, and developer demand — slots fill fast.
PayPal payouts go through Tremendous, which recently added a 6% fee on PayPal processing.
You are paid only for tests 'completed well' — all four quality rules (quiet recording, continuous talk-aloud, complete in-game tasks, detailed survey) must be met.

steps: Sign up at https://www.playtestcloud.com/ (become a playtester) — free.
Complete the short, unpaid Playtester Onboarding test to prove your commentary quality and device capability.
Wait for the review result (typically a couple of days); if you don't pass, you get feedback and can retry.
Accept playtest invitations by email — each invitation states the exact reward before you start.
Play the game while continuously talking through your thoughts aloud, complete all in-game tasks, then complete the post-test survey in detail.
Get paid $5–$9 per 15-minute playtest (reward shown in the invite); no minimum threshold to redeem.
timing: Paid for every test completed well; no payout threshold.
